items.prompt: Which contract makes a notional calculation easiest to reuse in tests and another component?

options.text: It always writes the result to a fixed production file
options.why: That introduces an external effect and environment dependency.

options.text: It returns cents and declares any validation or side effects
options.why: Callers can use the value while understanding the boundary.

options.text: It prints dollars but leaves the stored unit unspecified
options.why: That mixes representation and leaves the output ambiguous.

options.text: It silently converts every bad input to zero
options.why: That hides input failures as legitimate financial values.

items.explanation: A reusable contract specifies inputs, units, returned result and effects. Silent repair and fixed external writes make testing and composition less reliable.
